headline: DeepSeek's provider share slipped 7.1 points in a day, and StepFun barged into the top 10
summary: DeepSeek is still the undisputed leader, but its slice of the pie shrank noticeably today. Meanwhile, StepFun's step-5-preview arrived at rank 10 and four models fell off the board.
highlights: DeepSeek's provider share is now 28.8%, down 7.1 points over 24 hours, though its deepseek-v4.1-flash still holds rank 1 with 22.6% of tokens.
StepFun's step-5-preview debuted at rank 10 with 2.6% of tokens, the biggest newcomer by a wide margin.
The top two providers, DeepSeek and Zhipu AI, hold 39.8% between them, and adding OpenAI takes the top three to 49.3%.
Four models dropped out: qwen3.8-27b, qwen3.8-flash, gpt-6-luna-pro, and claude-fable-5.1.
Concentration (HHI) sits at 0.126312, up 0.007253 over the past 30 days.
